result.summary: The intersection is equipped with standard pedestrian infrastructure including zebra-marked crosswalks, pedestrian signals, and curb ramps. However, safety is compromised by active construction obstructing a corner and parked vehicles that limit visibility at the crossing points.

hazards.name: Construction Obstruction
hazards.description: An excavator and traffic cones are blocking the sidewalk and corner area, forcing pedestrians into the roadway.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk obscure sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement
hazards.description: Cracked and uneven asphalt in the crosswalk area increases trip hazards.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sightlines.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Safe Construction Management
interventions.description: Implement a clearly marked and protected temporary walkway around the construction site.

result.summary: The intersection features high-visibility zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides, providing basic pedestrian infrastructure. However, the wide roadway lacks physical protection such as curb extensions or refuge islands, and parked vehicles near the crossing may obstruct sightlines.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Exposure

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island

interventions.title: Pavement Resurfacing
